name: Beach Cafe Aufenfeld
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Beach Café Aufenfeld in Tirol!**

Relax by the serene waters of **Achenkirch** and enjoy the unique charm of our lakeside café. Savor delicious **Kaiserschmarrn**, fresh pastries, and refreshing drinks while soaking up the stunning Alpine views.

Whether you're looking for a peaceful retreat or a fun day out with family and friends, our cozy café offers the perfect spot to unwind. Try our famous **Tiroler Gröstl** or indulge in a creamy **Apfelstrudel**—every bite is a taste of **Tirol**’s culinary delights.

Come visit us and experience the perfect blend of lakeside leisure and authentic **Tiroler** hospitality!
